"""Every number and every open ruling in Playmaker lives here.

Numbers come straight from the rulebook, the trackers and the scenario rules.
Settings marked OQ-n match the numbered items in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md: each default
is the one the designer asked for, and a ruling is a one-line change here.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rules:
    # OQ-1: ball after an intercept or steal that plays on.
    #   'play_on' : ball back to the passer / stays with the carrier, -5, play continues.
    #   'end'     : the possession ends at that point.
    turnover_play_on: str = 'play_on'
    # OQ-2: when a pass resolves.
    #   'defence_turn' : on the defence's next turn (it may Intercept); if it doesn't,
    #                    the pass completes at the start of that turn.
    #   'immediate'    : completes at once unless a defender is already on the line.
    pass_resolution: str = 'defence_turn'
    # OQ-3: Sprint length = Move length + Quick Step, in one straight line.
    sprint_orth_base: int = MOVE_STRAIGHT
    sprint_diag_base: int = MOVE_DIAGONAL
    # OQ-4: roll bounds. A target >= 20 always succeeds, <= 0 always fails.
    natural_rolls: bool = False
    # OQ-5 (ruled): a declared shot worth less than 0 scores 0, matching the forced shot.
    floor_declared_shot: bool = True
    # OQ-6: defence reaction to a declared shot may use 0, 1 or 2 actions (movement, arrow
    #   turns, Steal) from the tokens still in the pool.
    reaction_kinds: tuple = ('move', 'qs', 'sprint', 'steal')
    reaction_may_decline: bool = True
    # OQ-7: defence out of tokens ends the phase at once (as written).
    defence_empty_ends_phase: bool = True
    # OQ-8: a wait (Hesitate / Pause) may not be played on the turn straight after the
    #   other side's wait.
    wait_chain_block: bool = True
    # OQ-9: screen geometry.
    #   'from_t_or_corner' : a defender's diagonal step is banned if it starts on the T
    #                        square or cuts the T square's corner (T is one of the two
    #                        squares the diagonal passes between).
    #   'from_t_only'      : only diagonal steps that start on the T square are banned.
    screen_geometry: str = 'from_t_or_corner'
    # OQ-29 (RULED, step 3i follow-up): how long a screen lasts and when it can be set.
    #   'hold_until_move' : a Screen is the turn's first action, or its second straight after that same
    #                       player's Move; it ends the turn and lasts until the screener moves (he may Move at
    #                       any time), a Challenge beats it (removed for every defender) or the phase ends.
    #   'two_turns'       : the old engine: any time in the turn; the screener can't move; it flips back after
    #                       the offence's next turn and survives the phase reset; a beaten Challenge lets that
    #                       one defender through.
    screen_rule: str = 'hold_until_move'
    # OQ-10: arrow line. A ball carrier move is illegal only if its path goes from one
    #   side of the ray to the other (touching or stepping onto the line is fine).
    arrow_line_strict: bool = True
    # Drives (RULED, step 3i follow-up). 'zone': the ball carrier may enter a square in the zone of a defender
    #   adjacent to him at the start of the movement, but no square of the path before the destination may
    #   lie in it, unless he beat that defender with a Dribble this phase. 'arrow_line': the old rule (the
    #   path may not cross the defender's arrow line).
    drive_rule: str = 'zone'
    # Intercept outcome (RULED, step 3i follow-up). True: an Intercept that wins (-5, the ball stays with the
    #   passer) puts the interceptor back on the square and arrow he had at the start of the defence's turn
    #   (his Move stays used); one that misses leaves him where he moved, on the pass line. False: the old
    #   engine (he stays on the pass line either way).
    intercept_return: bool = True
    # Interception (RULED, the OQ-72 refinement). 'move_then_intercept':
    #   the pass line is fixed from passer to receiver once the pass is declared;
    #   one defender answers in the defence's turn: (a) one Move, Quick Step or Sprint from his starting square,
    #   straight along one of his arrow lines, whose path crosses or ends on the pass line, ending on the
    #   pass-line square it meets (the corner-slip fix: a diagonal pass can't slip between corner-touching
    #   squares), a Sprint keeping his facing; then the Intercept (the defence's whole turn); or (b) through
    #   you: the line passes through his square, and the Intercept is his first action, whatever his facing;
    #   anything else first and the pass completes before that action: no other defender's action creates
    #   or opens an Intercept;
    #   the passer's ring: no Intercept on any square next to the passer (a defender there Steals instead).
    #   A failed Intercept (the pass completes) leaves him on the pass line with his Move used. What a
    #   successful one costs is turnover_cost.
    # 'ring_jump': the first OQ-72 ruling (the Intercept is itself a straight Move or Quick Step, a defender
    #   may follow first, success ends the possession). 'approach': the rule before OQ-72. Both kept so old
    #   logs replay.
    intercept_rule: str = 'move_then_intercept'
    # What a successful Intercept or Steal costs the offence (RULED, play-on; intercepts and steals alike).
    #   'minus5_lose_phase' : -5 and the shot clock loses one phase (2 seconds); the current phase goes on
    #                         with the same tokens and actions left; in the final phase the possession ends
    #                         and scores 0. The ball stays with the passer (an Intercept) or the carrier (a
    #                         Steal); a Steal on a declared shot cancels the shot (it doesn't use the phase's
    #                         shot) and play goes on.
    #   'minus5' | 'minus10' : the points only, play on.   'lose_phase' : the clock only (no points).
    #   'end_possession'     : the possession ends at -5.
    #   'legacy'             : the engine before this ruling (an Intercept as its intercept_rule says; a Steal
    #                          in play -5 and play on, on a declared shot the possession ends at -5).
    #   The old name intercept_cost is an alias (with_rules accepts it; Rules.intercept_cost reads it).
    turnover_cost: str = 'minus5_lose_phase'
    # OQ-11: a 1 straight + 1 diagonal Move may go in either order.
    move_either_order: bool = True
    # OQ-12 (ruled: the defence chooses any adjacent defender): contest choice.
    #   'min_value' : defence picks the adjacent defender (or none) that minimises the
    #                 expected shot value, counting foul free throws.
    #   'nearest'   : the nearest adjacent defender (rulebook wording), ties by min value.
    #   'player'    : (RULED, step 3b) the defence chooses: contest with any adjacent defender, or not.
    contest_choice: str = 'player'
    # ---- new questions found while building (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md 13+) ----
    # OQ-13 (RULED by the rulebook, Nov 2026): "Through you: the line passes through your square's centre."
    #   0 = the pass line passes exactly through the square's centre (as check_scenarios.py does; rows,
    #   columns, diagonals and the rational lines between); 0.5 was the engine's earlier reading (the line
    #   through the middle half of the square). Only 'through you' uses it under move_then_intercept: a lane
    #   jump is geometry (lane_meet).
    on_line_tolerance: float = 0
    # OQ-76 (RULED by the rulebook, Nov 2026): "Jump the lane: one straight Move, Quick Step or Sprint along your
    #   arrow, keeping your facing." True: the Move half of move-then-intercept keeps the defender's arrow (a
    #   Sprint always did, a Quick Step never turns). False: the engine before the ruling (the Move could turn).
    lane_jump_keeps_facing: bool = True
    # Receiver denial (RULED by the designer, Nov 2026): a pass may not travel through the square of a defender next
    #   to the receiver: the lane is blocked, not interceptable, whatever his facing. "Through" is the pass line within
    #   receiver_denial_tol of the defender's centre (half a square), strictly between passer and receiver. Defenders
    #   elsewhere on the line are unchanged (through-you intercept, the roll as normal). False: no denial.
    receiver_denial: bool = True
    receiver_denial_tol: float = 0.5
    # OQ-14: Quick Step may be shorter than the card value (up to 2, not exactly 2).
    qs_up_to: bool = True
    # OQ-15: a player with Quick Step 0 cannot Sprint.
    sprint_needs_qs: bool = True
    # OQ-52 (RULED): each player has one Quick Step a phase, and a Sprint uses it ("uses that player's
    #   Move and Quick Step", trackers). So no Sprint after that player's Quick Step, no Quick Step after
    #   their Sprint, no second Quick Step. The side's limit of 2 Quick Steps (Sprints count) still applies.
    qs_once_per_player: bool = True
    # A defender's arrow (RULED: back to the single arrow after the move-then-intercept run, where the single
    #   arrow with late closeout off was the cell closest to basketball; the wedge is kept available).
    #   'single' : one arrow line.
    #   'wedge'  : two arrow lines 45 degrees apart (directions a and a+1 for arrow index a): passes,
    #              drives, steals and contest facing test either line; a Sprint sets one edge to the run
    #              direction and the defender picks the side of the other.
    arrow_mode: str = 'single'
    # Step 3h (rule test, not adopted): contest quality.
    #   'current'      : any adjacent defender contests; arrow off the shooter = a foul roll; -3 when the
    #                    contester is further from the rim than the shooter.
    #   'wedge_mirror' : facing gates the contest (shooter on an arrow line); Front if the rim square
    #                    lies in the wedge mirrored backwards, Behind if it lies in the forward wedge,
    #                    else Side (needs arrow_mode 'wedge').
    #   'rim_distance' : facing gates the contest; Front if closer to the rim than the shooter, Side if
    #                    level, Behind if further.
    #   Front: full contest. Side: a foul roll (Foul contest rating). Behind: a foul roll and the -3.
    contest_geometry: str = 'current'
    # OQ-63 (RULED, step 3i): the ball carrier can't Screen (a handoff is a short pass, not a screen).
    carrier_can_screen: bool = False
    # Step 3i (rule test, not adopted): a contester who used a reaction movement (Move, Sprint or Quick
    #   Step) to reach the contest is late: at the rim, post or floater a foul roll; on a mid-range, long
    #   two or three the -3 and no foul roll. One who was already adjacent (and only turns) contests as now.
    late_closeout: bool = False
    # OQ-16 (ruled): who may Challenge a screen.
    #   'on_t'     : only the defender standing on the screen's T square (the one it blocks).
    #   'adjacent' : any defender next to the screener.   'any' : any defender.
    challenge_who: str = 'on_t'
    # OQ-17 (ruled): a locked ball carrier may not Dribble: a lost dribble means pass or shoot.
    locked_can_dribble: bool = False
    # OQ-18: a Dribble win frees the carrier from that defender's arrow line for the rest
    #   of the phase.
    dribble_win_lasts: str = 'phase'
    # OQ-19: before the inbound pass lands the inbounder may only Pass.
    inbounder_pass_only: bool = True
    # OQ-20 (ruled): the far-contest -3 never takes a contest below 0.
    floor_contest_zero: bool = True
    # OQ-21: a side with tokens but no legal action forfeits its remaining tokens.
    forfeit_when_stuck: bool = True
    # OQ-22: Need a Three: a two-point shot (and its free throws) scores 0.
    three_only_ft_on_twos: bool = False
    # OQ-23: Coach's Call bonus uses the band of the look (shot value, or free throws if fouled)
    #   and also applies to a forced shot by the target.
    coach_bonus_on_forced: bool = True
    # OQ-24: the arrow-line restriction applies to defenders adjacent at the start of the
    #   movement action.
    arrow_line_adjacent_at: str = 'start'
    # OQ-25: two diagonal steps of a Move go the same way (a straight diagonal line).
    diag_move_straight: bool = True
    # OQ-27 (ruled): on a failed inbound, a tie for "furthest from the rim" is the offence's
    #   choice ('offence'); 'lowest' gives the ball to the lowest piece number.
    inbound_tie: str = 'offence'
    # OQ-30 (RULED, step 3b): the forced shot's type at clock 0. 'player' = the offence picks among the
    #   types its zone allows; 'best' = the engine picks the best expected value.
    forced_shot_choice: str = 'player'
    # OQ-35 (ruled): an inbound pass works like any other pass. The defence gets its normal
    #   turn (1 or 2 actions: e.g. Move then Intercept, Sprint then Intercept, or move two
    #   players); the pass resolves after that turn, then the phase resets to the card's clock.
    #   'after_defence_turn' (ruled) | 'defence_turn_start' (step 1: lands at the start of the turn)
    inbound_resolves: str = 'after_defence_turn'
    # OQ-34 (new rule, the and-one): once a shot is declared (or forced at clock 0), any foul
    #   scores the higher of the free throws and the shot's uncontested value. Fouling a good
    #   look can then never help the defence. False = free throws only.
    and_one: bool = True

    @property
    def intercept_cost(self):
        return self.turnover_cost


# The step 3i follow-up rulings (screens, the wedge, drives through a zone, the interceptor's return): a log
# records these settings in its setup line; a log from before them replays with the old values.
RULED_3I = ('arrow_mode', 'screen_rule', 'drive_rule', 'intercept_return', 'late_closeout', 'intercept_rule',
            'turnover_cost', 'on_line_tolerance', 'lane_jump_keeps_facing', 'receiver_denial', 'receiver_denial_tol')
LEGACY_3I = dict(arrow_mode='single', screen_rule='two_turns', drive_rule='arrow_line', intercept_return=False,
                 intercept_rule='approach', turnover_cost='legacy', on_line_tolerance=0.5, lane_jump_keeps_facing=False,
                 receiver_denial=False)
# A log from before the rulebook revision of Nov 2026 (no on_line_tolerance / lane_jump_keeps_facing in its setup
# line) replays with the readings it was played under.
PRE_RULEBOOK = dict(on_line_tolerance=0.5, lane_jump_keeps_facing=False, receiver_denial=False)
# A log from before the receiver-denial ruling replays without it (a log recording the rulebook readings but not it).
PRE_DENIAL = dict(receiver_denial=False)
TURNOVER_COSTS = ('minus5_lose_phase', 'minus5', 'minus10', 'lose_phase', 'end_possession', 'legacy')
INTERCEPT_RULES = ('move_then_intercept', 'ring_jump', 'approach')

DEFAULT_RULES = Rules()


def with_rules(**changes):
    """A copy of the default rules with some settings changed (intercept_cost is the old name of
    turnover_cost)."""
    if 'intercept_cost' in changes:
        changes = dict(changes)
        changes['turnover_cost'] = changes.pop('intercept_cost')
    return replace(DEFAULT_RULES, **changes)

"""The computer defence that reads the board (step 3e).

The greedy baseline scores a defensive action by the carrier's shot *right now*, judged from the current
arrow facings. That makes "arrow on the shooter" win almost every time, although any defender with their
Move and a token left can turn (or step in) to face the shooter as a reaction once the shot is declared.

This defence scores each candidate turn with the solver's evaluation instead, which already counts
reaction-reachable contests (a defender whose Move is unused, who is not locked, with a token in the
pool, can still get adjacent and facing as a reaction) and looks one offence turn ahead (shoot now,
drive, or pass and then shoot). Walls and lanes start to score, and holding a reaction back is valued.

It plays only from the legal actions, reads only the board and the cards (what a human sees), and never
looks at the offence's secret Coach's Call target.
"""
from . import board as B
from . import geometry as G
from .actions import legal_actions
from .policies import Policy, GreedyPolicy, expected
from .resolve import apply, ChanceNode


def arrow_job(state, j):
    """What defender j's arrow is doing, in the rules' four jobs (for logs, tests and the review):
    'on_ball' (on the ball carrier: Steal and a clean contest), 'wall' (adjacent to the carrier, line
    across the carrier's way to the rim), 'lane' (the line crosses a pass from the carrier to a teammate),
    'help' (the line crosses the carrier's drive path to the rim), 'on_man' (on the nearest other
    attacker) or 'other'."""
    xp, a = state.x[j], state.arrows[j]
    cp = state.o[state.ball]          # off the court during an inbound: only the lanes matter then
    inside = B.on_board(cp)
    R = state.ctx.rules
    if G.faces(R, a, xp, cp):
        return 'on_ball'
    rim = B.RIM
    if inside and B.adjacent(xp, cp) and G.crosses(R, xp, a, cp, rim):
        return 'wall'
    for i, op in enumerate(state.o):
        if i != state.ball and B.on_board(op) and G.crosses(R, xp, a, cp, op):
            return 'lane'
    if inside and G.crosses(R, xp, a, cp, rim):
        return 'help'
    others = [op for i, op in enumerate(state.o) if i != state.ball and B.on_board(op)]
    if others:
        near = min(others, key=lambda op: B.cheb(op, xp))
        if B.adjacent(xp, near) and a == B.dir_between(xp, near):
            return 'on_man'
    return 'other'


DEFAULT_BUDGET_S = 2.5          # thinking time per decision (the in-browser build sets a lower one)


class ReadingDefence(Policy):
    """Defence: the candidate turn (the solver's defence plays, plus every single legal action for the
    reaction and the contest choice) with the lowest value under the solver's two-turn evaluation.
    Offence: the greedy baseline (unchanged)."""
    name = 'reader'

    def __init__(self, eval_turns=1, budget_s='default'):
        budget_s = DEFAULT_BUDGET_S if budget_s == 'default' else budget_s
        self.budget_s = budget_s      # thinking time per decision; the best play so far is used after that
        from .solver import Evaluator, Generator
        from .solver_config import with_config
        self.cfg = with_config(eval_turns=eval_turns)
        self._Evaluator, self._Generator = Evaluator, Generator
        self._ctx = None
        self._fresh()
        self.offence = GreedyPolicy()

    def _fresh(self):
        # the solver's caches key positions without their context (teams, rules): one set per context
        self.ev = self._Evaluator(self.cfg)
        self.gen = self._Generator(self.cfg, self.ev)
        self.plan = None

    def _context(self, state):
        if state.ctx is not self._ctx:
            self._ctx = state.ctx
            self._fresh()

    def reset(self, seed):
        self.offence.reset(seed)
        self.plan = None

    def choose(self, state):
        acts = legal_actions(state)
        if len(acts) == 1:
            return acts[0]
        defending = state.stage in ('contest', 'reaction') or (state.stage == 'play' and state.side == 'X')
        if not defending:
            return self.offence.choose(state)
        self._context(state)
        if self.plan and self.plan[0] == state and self.plan[1]:
            a = self.plan[1][0]
            if a in acts:
                self._advance(state, a, self.plan[1][1:])
                return a
        self.plan = None
        best = self.best_play(state, acts)
        if best is None:
            return GreedyPolicy().choose(state)
        a = best.actions[0]
        self._advance(state, a, best.actions[1:])
        return a

    def _advance(self, state, a, rest):
        nxt = apply(state, a)
        self.plan = (nxt, rest) if rest and not isinstance(nxt, ChanceNode) else None

    def value(self, node):
        return expected(node, lambda s: self.ev(s)[0].ev)

    def best_play(self, state, acts=None):
        from .solver import Play, apply_play
        self._context(state)
        if state.ctx.coach_call and state.stage != 'over':
            state = state.with_(target=-1)        # the defence never sees the offence's secret target
        acts = acts if acts is not None else legal_actions(state)
        plays = self.gen.plays(state, shallow=False)
        if state.stage in ('reaction', 'contest') or state.pending:
            have = {p.actions for p in plays}
            plays += [Play('single', (a,)) for a in acts if (a,) not in have]
        import time
        stop = time.time() + self.budget_s if self.budget_s else None
        best, best_v = None, None
        for p in plays:
            if stop is not None and best is not None and time.time() > stop:
                break
            node = apply_play(state, p)
            if node is None:
                continue
            v = self.value(node)
            # spend a token only for a real gain: ties go to the play with fewer actions
            v += sum(a.kind != 'end_turn' for a in p.actions) * 1e-6
            if best_v is None or v < best_v:
                best, best_v = p, v
        return best


def choose_arrows(state, passes=2):
    """Setup arrows for a placed defence: start from each defender facing its man, then (coordinate
    descent) turn one defender at a time to the facing that leaves the offence the lowest value under the
    solver's evaluation. Squares are not changed."""
    from .solver import Evaluator
    from .solver_config import with_config
    ev = Evaluator(with_config(eval_turns=1))
    arrows = list(state.arrows)
    best = ev(state)[0].ev
    for _ in range(passes):
        changed = False
        for j in range(5):
            for d in range(8):
                if d == arrows[j]:
                    continue
                trial = arrows[:j] + [d] + arrows[j + 1:]
                v = ev(state.with_(arrows=tuple(trial)))[0].ev
                if v < best - 1e-9:
                    best, arrows, changed = v, trial, True
        if not changed:
            break
    return arrows

from dataclasses import dataclass, replace


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SolverConfig:
    # ---- exact endgame solver ----
    endgame_tokens: int = 2          # N: positions in the final phase with <= N tokens per side go exact
    exact_node_cap: int = 4000       # give up on an exact solve after this many applies (fall back to guided)
    # ---- candidate generator ----
    top_k_raw: int = 8               # K: best raw actions (by evaluation) added to the concept plays
    raw_depth: int = 1               # add raw actions only this many plies from the root
    drive_k: int = 3                 # drive / drive-and-shoot squares per node
    relocate_k: int = 2              # off-ball relocations per node
    closeout_k: int = 4              # closeouts per node (outside the reaction to a shot)
    combo_k: int = 3                 # defence two-action combos built from the top single plays
    contain_k: int = 2               # the carrier's best step-then-shoot squares the defence plays to contain
    # ---- guided search ----
    beam: int = 6                    # plays kept per node below the root (ordered by evaluation)
    root_beam: int = 40              # plays kept at the root
    max_depth: int = 12              # iterative deepening limit, in turns
    # ---- evaluation ----
    eval_turns: int = 2              # the evaluation looks over the offence's next N turns (1 or 2)
    eval_setup_k: int = 4            # offence setup plays (pass / relocate / drive...) tried in turn 1
    eval_reply_k: int = 4            # defence replies tried to each setup
    # small positional terms (kept only if they improve agreement with the exact solver; see report)
    term_open_lane: float = 0.0      # per point of the best open-lane receiver's look above the carrier's
    term_zone: float = 0.0           # bonus if the carrier stands on a shooting zone (not plain wood)
    quiescence: bool = True          # a leaf where the defence is to move gets one more defence turn
    quiescence_beam: int = 12        # defence plays kept in that extra turn (ball-side plays only, no combos)
    kick_weight: float = 0.0         # value of the best teammate look (0 = carrier only); tested in the report
    inbound_kick_weight: float = 1.0 # during an inbound the ball must go in: use the best receiver's look
    # ---- budgets and confidence ----
    budgets_min: tuple = (2.0, 10.0) # time budgets per card, minutes
    seeds: int = 5
    unstable_spread: float = 2.0     # value spread (points) above which a card is unstable
    # ---- verdicts ----
    gift_p30: float = 0.75
    wall_p30: float = 0.15
    wall_look: float = 20.0
    plan_share: float = 0.90         # a plan counts if it reaches this share of the best value
    goal: int = 30


DEFAULT = SolverConfig()


def with_config(**kw):
    return replace(DEFAULT, **kw)

def card_json(card, side):

    r = lambda n: dict(name=LABELS[n], value=card.r[n], band=card.bands[n], mark=MARK[card.bands[n]])
    groups = [dict(name='Actions', ratings=[dict(name='Quick Step', value=card.qs, band='A', mark='')]

                ratings=[r(n) for n in names], groups=groups)

def arrow_lines(s):
    """Arrow lines the ball carrier can't cross (adjacent defenders, not beaten by a Dribble)."""
    c = s.o[s.ball]
    out = []
    for j, xp in enumerate(s.x):
        if B.adjacent(xp, c) and (s.ball, j) not in s.beaten:
            for d in G.lines(s.ctx.rules, s.arrows[j]):        # a wedge (step 3h) has two lines
                e = B.ray_end(xp, d)
                out.append(dict(defender=j, start=list(xp), end=[float(e[0]), float(e[1])]))
    return out


def influence(s):
    """Everything the board shows always, to both players at every detail level (step 3i follow-up):
    each defender's zone of influence (the movement that reaches each square: a Move or Quick Step solid,
    a Sprint as the lighter extension), each active screen's T and the diagonal steps it blocks, capacity
    badges (Move used, Quick Step used, locked) for every piece, and each attacker's movement reach this
    phase (shown when he is selected)."""
    from playmaker_engine.actions import zone, movement_dests, can_move_kind
    rules = s.ctx.rules
    zones = []
    for j in range(5):
        z = zone(s, j)
        zones.append(dict(defender=j, lines=list(G.lines(rules, s.arrows[j])),
                          squares=[dict(sq=B.sq(q), x=q[0], y=q[1], kind=k) for q, k in sorted(z.items())]))
    screens = []
    for sc in s.screens:
        t = B.add(s.o[sc[0]], B.DIRS[sc[1]])
        blocked = []
        for a in [t] + [B.add(t, d) for d in B.DIRS]:
            for d in B.DIRS:
                b = B.add(a, d)
                if B.on_board(a) and B.on_board(b) and B.diag_step_banned(a, b, t, rules):
                    if [b[0], b[1], a[0], a[1]] not in blocked:
                        blocked.append([a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1]])
        screens.append(dict(screener=sc[0], t=dict(sq=B.sq(t), x=t[0], y=t[1]), blocked=blocked))
    st = s if (s.side == 'O' and s.stage == 'play') else s.with_(side='O', stage='play')
    reach = []
    for i in range(5):
        sq = set()
        for kind in ('move', 'qs', 'sprint'):
            if can_move_kind(st, 'O', i, kind):
                sq |= set(movement_dests(st, 'O', i, kind, rules))
        reach.append([dict(sq=B.sq(q), x=q[0], y=q[1]) for q in sorted(sq)])
    badges = dict(O=[dict(move=s.moved('O', i), qs=s.quick_stepped('O', i), locked=s.locked('O', i)) for i in range(5)],
                  X=[dict(move=s.moved('X', j), qs=s.quick_stepped('X', j), locked=s.locked('X', j)) for j in range(5)])
    return dict(zones=zones, screens=screens, reach=reach, badges=badges, arrow_mode=rules.arrow_mode,
                drive_rule=rules.drive_rule)


def rv(card, name):
    """A rating as the card prints it: value plus its ▲ / ▼ mark."""
    return f'{card.r[name]}{MARK[card.bands[name]]}'


SHOT_NAME = {'layup': 'Layup', 'dunk': 'Dunk', 'post': 'Post', 'floater': 'Floater', 'mid': 'Mid', 'long': 'Long 2',

def shot_chips(s, shooter, t):
    """The comparison the tracker tells players to make, for a shot: rating v each eligible contester."""
    card = s.ctx.off[shooter]
    sp = s.o[shooter]
    out = []
    for j, xp in enumerate(s.x):
        if B.adjacent(xp, sp):
            eligible, foul_roll, penalty, cat = G.terms(s.ctx.rules, xp, s.arrows[j], sp)
            if not eligible:
                continue                      # step 3h geometries: lines off the shooter, no contest
            if s.ctx.rules.contest_geometry == 'current':
                far = ' (further from the rim: −3)' if penalty else ''
                why = 'arrow off'
            else:
                far = ' (behind: −3)' if penalty else ''
                why = cat
            out.append(f'{SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(card, "shot_" + t)} v contest {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "con_" + t)} (X{j + 1}){far}'
                       + ('' if not foul_roll else f', {why}: foul roll on Foul {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "foul_contest")}'))
    if not out:
        out.append(f'{SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(card, "shot_" + t)} v no contester next to the shooter now')
    return out


def matchups(s):
    """Who guards whom, as the board shows it: an adjacent defender whose arrow points at the player,
    otherwise the nearest (all tied nearest). The same for both players."""
    def pick(me, others, arrows_of_others=None, arrow_me=None):
        out = []
        if arrows_of_others is not None:
            out = [j for j, q in enumerate(others) if B.adjacent(q, me) and arrows_of_others[j] == B.dir_between(q, me)]
        if arrow_me is not None:
            out = [j for j, q in enumerate(others) if B.adjacent(q, me) and arrow_me == B.dir_between(me, q)]
        if out:
            return out
        d = [B.cheb(q, me) for q in others]
        m = min(d)
        return [j for j, v in enumerate(d) if v == m]
    return dict(O=[pick(p, s.x, arrows_of_others=s.arrows) for p in s.o],
                X=[pick(p, s.o, arrow_me=s.arrows[i]) for i, p in enumerate(s.x)])


def denied_json(s):
    """The carrier's denied lanes (receiver denial): a pass that would go through a defender next to the receiver."""
    from playmaker_engine.actions import denied_lanes
    if s.stage not in ('play',) or s.ball is None or s.ball < 0 or not B.on_board(s.o[s.ball]):
        return []
    return [dict(receiver=d['receiver'], defender=d['defender'], rsq=B.sq(s.o[d['receiver']]), dsq=B.sq(s.x[d['defender']]))
            for d in denied_lanes(s)]


def legal_json(s, acts):
    out = []
    for a in acts:
        d = action_to_json(a)
        if a.kind in CHANCE_KINDS or (a.kind == 'end_turn' and s.stage == 'reaction'):
            d['roll'] = chance_preview(s, a)
        if a.kind == 'pass' and s.ctx.rules.intercept_rule in ('ring_jump', 'move_then_intercept'):
            from playmaker_engine.actions import lane_marks
            from playmaker_engine.resolve import apply as _apply
            pend = _apply(s, a)
            marks, ring = lane_marks(pend) if getattr(pend, 'pending', None) else ([], [])
            d['threats'] = [dict(defender=m['defender'], how=m['how'], sq=B.sq(m['sq']), x=m['sq'][0], y=m['sq'][1],
                                 by=m['by'], via=B.sq(m['via']) if m['via'] else None) for m in marks]
            d['ring'] = [dict(sq=B.sq(q), x=q[0], y=q[1]) for q in ring if B.on_board(q)]
            uniq = sorted({t['defender'] for t in d['threats']})
            d['chips'] = [f'Pass {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "pass")} v Intercept {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "intercept")} (X{j + 1})' for j in uniq]
        elif a.kind == 'pass':
            pend = s.with_(pending=(a.piece, a.target))
            d['threats'] = [dict(defender=j, how=intercept_status(pend, j)) for j in range(5)
                            if intercept_status(pend, j)]
            d['chips'] = [f'Pass {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "pass")} v Intercept {rv(s.ctx.dfn[t["defender"]], "intercept")} '
                          f'(X{t["defender"] + 1})' for t in d['threats']]
        if a.kind == 'dribble':
            d['chips'] = [f'Dribble {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "dribble")} v Agility {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.target], "agility")} (X{a.target + 1})']
        if a.kind == 'screen':
            tq = B.add(s.o[a.piece], B.DIRS[a.target])
            d['chips'] = [f'Screen {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "screen")} v Challenge {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "challenge")} (X{j + 1} on the T square)'
                          for j, xp in enumerate(s.x) if xp == tq]
        if a.kind == 'steal':
            d['chips'] = [f'Steal {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "steal")} v Dribble {rv(s.ctx.off[s.ball], "dribble")} (O{s.ball + 1})',
                          f'Foul (steal) {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "foul_steal")}: a straight foul roll first']
        if a.kind == 'intercept':
            d['chips'] = [f'Intercept {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "intercept")} v Pass {rv(s.ctx.off[s.pending[0]], "pass")} (O{s.pending[0] + 1})']
        if a.kind == 'challenge':
            d['chips'] = [f'Challenge {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "challenge")} v Screen {rv(s.ctx.off[a.target], "screen")} (O{a.target + 1})']
        if a.kind == 'contest':
            opts = {o.defender: o for o in contest_options(s, s.ball, s.shot, s.forced)}
            o = opts[a.piece]
            sh = s.ctx.off[s.ball]
            t = s.shot
            if a.piece < 0:
                d['option'] = f"Don't contest: {SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(sh, 'shot_' + t)} v no contest"
            else:
                dc = s.ctx.dfn[a.piece]
                far = ', further from the rim: −3' if o.contest < dc.con(t) else ''
                d['option'] = (f'Contest with X{a.piece + 1}: {SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(sh, "shot_" + t)} v contest '
                               f'{rv(dc, "con_" + t)}{far}, ' + ('arrow on the shooter (clean)' if o.clean else
                               f'arrow off the shooter: foul roll on Foul {rv(dc, "foul_contest")}'))
            d['clean'] = bool(o.clean)
        if a.kind == 'forced_shot':
            d['chips'] = shot_chips(s, a.piece, a.shot)
        if a.kind == 'shot':
            d['chips'] = shot_chips(s, a.piece, a.shot)
        out.append(d)
    return out


def turn_summary(s):
    if s.stage == 'contest':
        return 'Contest: the defence chooses who contests the shot (or nobody)'
    if s.stage == 'forced':
        return 'Shot clock out: the offence chooses the forced shot (turnover, −5 as well)'
    if s.stage == 'over':
        return 'Possession over'
    if s.stage == 'target':
        return "Coach's Call: the offence writes its secret target (defence, look away)"
    if s.stage == 'pick':
        return 'Failed inbound: the offence chooses who gets the ball'
    if s.stage == 'reaction':
        left = min(2 - s.turn_n, s.tok_x)
        return f'Shot declared ({s.shot}). Defence reacts: {left} action{"s" if left != 1 else ""} left, then the contest'
    who = 'Offence' if s.side == 'O' else 'Defence'
    left = min(2 - s.turn_n, s.tokens(s.side))
    extra = ' · final turn of the phase' if s.side == 'X' and s.final else ''
    wk = 'pause' if s.side == 'X' else 'hesitate'
    wait = RC.LIMITS[s.side][wk]
    extra += f" · {wk.capitalize()}: {wait} a phase{' (used)' if s.count(s.side, wk) >= wait else ''}"
    if s.pending:
        extra += ' · a pass is in the air'
    return f'{who} turn: {left} action{"s" if left != 1 else ""} left · a turn-ender ends it now{extra}'


def board_json(s, slots=None):
    """The board after one action, small enough to keep with every feed entry: the page steps through the
    other side's turn one action at a time (where each piece stood, arrows, ball, clock, tokens)."""
    o = []
    for i, p in enumerate(s.o):
        sc = s.screen_of(i)
        o.append(dict(sq=B.sq(p), x=p[0], y=p[1], ball=i == s.ball, locked=s.locked('O', i), moved=s.moved('O', i),
                      slots=list(slots['O'][i]) if slots else [],
                      screen=dict(dir=sc[1], t=B.sq(B.add(p, B.DIRS[sc[1]]))) if sc else None))
    x = [dict(sq=B.sq(p), x=p[0], y=p[1], arrow=s.arrows[i], arrow_name=B.DIR_NAMES[s.arrows[i]],
              locked=s.locked('X', i), moved=s.moved('X', i), slots=list(slots['X'][i]) if slots else [])
         for i, p in enumerate(s.x)]
    return dict(o=o, x=x, clock=s.clock, phase=s.phase, stage=s.stage, tokens=dict(O=s.tok_o, X=s.tok_x),
                pending=list(s.pending) if s.pending else None, inbound=s.inbound, shot=s.shot,
                arrow_lines=arrow_lines(s) if B.on_board(s.o[s.ball]) and s.ctx.rules.drive_rule == 'arrow_line' else [],
                summary=turn_summary(s), bonus=RC.STEAL_FOUL_BONUS * s.bonus5, turnovers=s.tos,
                influence=influence(s) if s.stage != 'over' else None)


def state_json(game, token):
    game.timer_tick()                    # apply any forfeit that fell due before reading the state
    s = game.state
    ctx = s.ctx
    seat = game.seat_of(token)
    can = game.can_act(token)
    show_target = s.stage == 'over' or seat == 'O' or (game.mode == 'hotseat' and False)
    pieces_o = []
    for i, p in enumerate(s.o):
        sc = s.screen_of(i)
        pieces_o.append(dict(i=i, sq=B.sq(p), x=p[0], y=p[1], ball=i == s.ball, locked=s.locked('O', i),
                             moved=s.moved('O', i), slots=game.slots['O'][i],
                             screen=dict(dir=sc[1], t=B.sq(B.add(p, B.DIRS[sc[1]]))) if sc else None,
                             card=card_json(ctx.off[i], 'O')))
    pieces_x = []
    for i, p in enumerate(s.x):
        pieces_x.append(dict(i=i, sq=B.sq(p), x=p[0], y=p[1], arrow=s.arrows[i], arrow_name=B.DIR_NAMES[s.arrows[i]],
                             locked=s.locked('X', i), moved=s.moved('X', i), slots=game.slots['X'][i],
                             card=card_json(ctx.dfn[i], 'X')))
    limits = {side: [dict(kind=k, used=s.count(side, k), limit=v) for k, v in RC.LIMITS[side].items()]
              for side in ('O', 'X')}
    sc_info = None
    if game.scenario:
        c = SCENARIOS[game.scenario]
        sc_info = dict(n=game.scenario, title=c['title'], kind=c['kind'], clock=c['clock'], text=c['text'],
                       goal='An Excellent look: shot value 30 or more.',
                       rules=_scenario_rules(c), off=c['off'], dfn=c['dfn'])
    result = None
    if s.stage == 'over':
        sc = score(s)
        result = _score_json(sc)
    legal = legal_json(s, game.legal()) if can else []
    placing = None
    if game.placing:
        o_sq = game.placed.get('O', (None,))[0]
        occupied = {B.sq(q) for q in o_sq} if o_sq else set()
        squares = [B.sq((x, y)) for y in range(1, B.H + 1) for x in range(B.W)]
        placing = dict(side=game.placing, by_ai=game.placing in game.ai,
                       mine=(seat == 'both' or seat == game.placing) and game.placing not in game.ai,
                       squares=[q for q in squares if q not in occupied],
                       ball_squares=[q for q in squares if B.zone(B.parse_sq(q)) == '.' and B.parse_sq(q)[1] > 1],
                       offence=[B.sq(q) for q in o_sq] if o_sq else None,
                       ball=game.placed.get('O', (None, None))[1])
    inbound_note = ('Inbounder: can only pass. The defence answers the pass with its normal turn.'
                    if s.inbound else None)
    out = dict(code=game.code, mode=game.mode, version=game.version, seat=seat, can_act=can,
                side_to_act=game.side_to_act(), ai=game.ai, title=ctx.title, scenario=sc_info, full=game.full,
                possession=game.possession, attacker=game.offence_player(), teams=[ctx.off_team, ctx.def_team],
                clock=s.clock, phase=s.phase, stage=s.stage, side=s.side, turn_n=s.turn_n, final=s.final, turn=game.turn_no,
                tokens=dict(O=s.tok_o, X=s.tok_x), limits=limits, inbound=s.inbound, inbounder=ctx.inbounder,
                pending=list(s.pending) if s.pending else None, shot=s.shot,
                o=pieces_o, x=pieces_x, zones=zones(),
                arrow_lines=arrow_lines(s) if B.on_board(s.o[s.ball]) and ctx.rules.drive_rule == 'arrow_line' else [],
                bonus=RC.STEAL_FOUL_BONUS * s.bonus5, turnovers=s.tos, fouls=s.fouls,
                target=(s.target if show_target else ('secret' if s.target >= 0 else None)),
                summary=turn_summary(s), rolls=game.rolls, result=result, scores=game.scores, match=game.match,
                legal=legal, can_undo=bool(game.undo), undo_votes=sorted(game.undo_votes),
                feedback_questions=FEEDBACK_QUESTIONS, feedback_done=game.feedback is not None,
                feedback_due=game.feedback_due(), placing=placing, inbound_note=inbound_note,
                log_name=game.log_name, static=getattr(game, 'static', False),
                feed=game.feed[-40:], feed_n=len(game.feed),
                level=game.level, scout=scout_json(game, seat), matchups=matchups(s), denied=denied_json(s),
                custom=game.custom or None, experimental=game.experimental,
                bands=[dict(name=n, low=lo) for n, lo in RC.BANDS], screen_rule=ctx.rules.screen_rule,
                influence=influence(s))
    if game.timer:
        out['timer'] = game.timer_json()
    return out


def _scenario_rules(c):
    out = []
    if c['kind'] == 'INBOUNDS' or c.get('inb'):
        out.append('Inbounds: two phases to complete a pass from the inbounder; the clock does not run yet. '
                   'The defence answers the pass with its normal turn; then the clock starts at the card\'s number.')
    if c.get('target'):
        out.append("Coach's Call: the offence secretly names a target. If the target takes the shot: "
                   'Poor +0, Okay +2, Good +5, Great +8, Excellent +10.')
    if c['title'] == 'Need a Three':
        out.append('Only a three-point shot scores.')
    if c['title'] == 'Two or Three':
        out.append('An Excellent three wins; an Excellent two ties.')
    if c['title'] == 'Hold for One':
        out.append('No shot before the final phase (clock on 2). A turnover ends the possession at 0.')
    if c['title'] == 'In the Bonus':
        out.append('The offence starts on +5; the next steal foul gives free throws.')
    if c['title'] == 'Star Locked':
        out.append('O1 starts locked until the phase resets. He can still pass or shoot.')
    if c['title'] == 'Late Clock Reset':
        out.append("Both Screens are spent; O5's screen is still standing. Offence 4 tokens, defence 4.")
    return out


def scout_json(game, seat=None):
    """The pre-game report (identical for both players) and the pick status (picks stay private).
    At Scout level the report is only sent once this client's picks are locked."""
    from playmaker_engine.scouting import report
    rep = (report(game.team_of('O'), game.team_of('X'), game.level, full=game.full)
           if game.report_visible(seat) else None)
    return dict(report=rep, locked=game.level == 'scout' and rep is not None,
                mine=game.picks.get(seat) if seat in ('O', 'X') else None, needs={side: game.picks_needed(side) for side in ('O', 'X')},
                done=sorted(game.picks), pending=game.picks_pending(),
                ai=[side for side in ('O', 'X') if side in game.ai],
                teams=dict(O=game.team_of('O'), X=game.team_of('X')))
